crownPassive.name: Vampire court
crownPassive.text: All your heroes heal 1 whenever their attacks damage a card. In rounds when you hold the Fate token, they heal 2 instead and have +1 Speed.

bond.name: Master
bond.text: When another of your Gothic heroes dies, he heals 4.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Standard attack on the closest enemy.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: A Ranged attack on any enemy card, then heal equal to the damage dealt.

actions.name: Turn
actions.text: Destroy an enemy front-rank card, or an enemy hero that is not the Crown, on 3 health or less. A Thrall copy of it fills one of your empty front-rank slots until the fight ends.
